phase3_findings.description: scripts/ensure-label.sh unconditionally runs `shopt -u nocasematch` after its case block rather than saving/restoring the prior setting; latent only (invoked solely as a subprocess, so shopt state does not leak today).
phase3_findings.disposition: Real, non-blocking. Corroborated independently by the final-pass reviewer.

phase3_findings.description: lib/test/run.sh #1855 comment says the `tr|sed|grep normalizer ... moved INTO apply-labels.sh`; the helper deliberately forbids that pipeline (bash-builtins only), so the wording could mislead a reader. Behavior-inert test prose.

Six-shape config matrix: the explicitly-false-like (JSON boolean/number scalar) row is dismissed by comment rather than asserted; empty-string stands in for valid-falsy. A one-line assert would close it.
phase3_findings.disposition: Minor coverage gap; overall coverage adequate.

phase3_findings.description: config-unreadable exercised via corrupt-JSON rc!=0 only, not a genuinely absent python3; and --config-key mode combined with a non-numeric number (config-mode arg-slip) is untested; apply-labels idempotency asserted only transitively via ensure-label.
phase3_findings.disposition: Minor coverage gaps on same downstream branches; non-blocking.

phase_4_1_report.summary: Independent blinded shadow re-review of PR #1936 converges on APPROVE. The change folds label config-resolution + outcome classification into scripts/apply-labels.sh (new --config-key/--config-fallback flags plus a closed five-value stdout outcome-token set: applied, nothing-to-apply, arg-slip, api-failure, config-unreadable), replaces grep with a bash `case`/`nocasematch` in scripts/ensure-label.sh, collapses the four implement-tier label call sites to a single apply-labels.sh invocation each, updates the create-issue cross-skill pointer, adds behavioral lib/test/run.sh pins, corrects docs/internal prose, and adds a changeset.

independent_correctness_checks_by_orches: Verified live that scripts/config-get.sh coerce() emits the literal `[object Object]` (rc 0) for a JSON object and `X,[object Object]` for a mixed array, so apply-labels.sh's SUBSTRING wrong-type guard and its test are sound (an early suspicion that the sentinel was JS-only dead code was disproved).
Confirmed NUMBER=${1:-} is captured before flag parsing so the issue number is not swallowed into the label list.
Confirmed `set -- "$_CFG_RAW"` is quoted, preserving spaces in multi-word labels while comma-splitting downstream.
Adjudicated the code-reviewer's Critical + scope findings as stale-base false positives via git merge-base against origin/main.
